--- title: "APEC Cities" author: "DK" date: "2026-01-26" draft: yes execute: echo: false warning: false messages: false categories: [korean cities] --- Korean provinces are named after its leading cities. For example, the province of 충청도 derives its name from cities of **충**주 and **청**주. Likewise 경상도 is named after **경**주 and **상**주. We lived about an hour from 경주, 55km away from the site of Shilla (신라) Dynasty capital. But we didn't fully take advantage of it. Much like visiting downtown DC only when visitors came, when we lived in Maryland. We bought a EtO gas sterilizer made near Barcelona, Spain. First the installers came, with their local wine hidden away inside the chamber. They were a gregarious bunch. Played a soccer match. A local version of Spain vs Korea, foreshadowing the 2002 World Cup. Then the owners came. They explained they go to installation sites, wherever the equipment is installed. I was impressed. ``` ::: ::: Often in life, we live near a city or locale that we should visit and learn from. We don't realize how valuable they are until a visitor points it out.
